splitPolicy: Every semantic template or generation family belongs to exactly one split. Paraphrases and mutations inherit the family's split; random row splitting is forbidden.
freezePolicy: Never edit this file or its JSONL in place after review. Create a new versioned corpus and manifest with a new hash.
personalDataPolicy: Synthetic examples only. Saved owner questions are separate on-device evaluation inputs and may not be copied here, uploaded, or used for training.
